ko.title: AI 지출 영수증: 다음 주 빅테크 실적 발표가 1조 달러의 베팅에 대해 밝혀낼 것들

segments.src: Over the next several days, some of the largest technology companies in the world will open their books for the latest quarter.
segments.tr: 향후 며칠 동안 세계 최대 규모의 기술 기업 중 일부가 지난 분기 장부를 공개할 예정입니다.

segments.src: Revenue and profit will get the headlines, as they always do.
segments.tr: 언제나 그렇듯 매출과 이익이 헤드라인을 장식할 것입니다.

segments.src: But this earnings season, the number many investors care about most sits a little further down the page: **how much these companies are spending on chips and data centers, and whether that spending is beginning to pay off.**
segments.tr: 하지만 이번 실적 시즌에 많은 투자자들이 가장 중요하게 생각하는 수치는 페이지 조금 더 아래쪽에 있습니다. **이 기업들이 칩과 데이터 센터에 얼마나 지출하고 있는지, 그리고 그 지출이 결실을 맺기 시작하고 있는지입니다.**

segments.src: That question matters well beyond Wall Street.
segments.tr: 이 질문은 월스트리트를 넘어 훨씬 더 넓은 영역에 영향을 미칩니다.

segments.src: The answer can influence tech stock prices, the value of retirement accounts that hold them, and the pace of the broader economy.
segments.tr: 그 답은 기술주 주가, 이를 보유한 은퇴 계좌의 가치, 그리고 광범위한 경제의 속도에 영향을 미칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Why this earnings season is different
segments.tr: ## 이번 실적 시즌이 다른 이유

segments.src: For years, big tech earnings followed a familiar script: advertising, cloud subscriptions, devices and software.
segments.tr: 수년 동안 빅테크의 실적은 광고, 클라우드 구독, 기기 및 소프트웨어라는 익숙한 대본을 따랐습니다.

segments.src: Since the rise of generative artificial intelligence, a new line item has taken center stage.
segments.tr: 생성형 인공지능이 부상한 이래로, 새로운 세부 항목이 중심 무대를 차지했습니다.

segments.src: **Capital expenditures**, often shortened to "capex," refers to money spent on long-lived assets such as data centers, servers, networking gear and specialized AI chips.
segments.tr: 흔히 "capex"로 줄여 부르는 **자본 지출**은 데이터 센터, 서버, 네트워크 장비, 전용 AI 칩과 같은 장기 자산에 쓰인 돈을 의미합니다.

segments.src: Across the industry, the combined capex plans of the largest cloud and platform companies have climbed to levels that analysts often describe in the hundreds of billions of dollars per year.
segments.tr: 업계 전체적으로 최대 클라우드 및 플랫폼 기업들의 합산 capex 계획은 분석가들이 연간 수천억 달러 규모로 설명하는 수준까지 치솟았습니다.

segments.src: Taken together with commitments over several years, the total is frequently framed as a trillion-dollar bet that AI will become a core part of how people and businesses work.
segments.tr: 수년에 걸친 약속과 합쳐지면, 이 총액은 AI가 사람들과 기업이 일하는 방식의 핵심이 될 것이라는 1조 달러 규모의 베팅으로 자주 표현됩니다.

segments.src: A bet that large raises an obvious question: where is the return?
segments.tr: 그 정도로 큰 베팅은 당연한 질문을 던지게 만듭니다. 수익은 어디에 있는가?

segments.src: ## What investors will be watching
segments.tr: ## 투자자들이 주시할 핵심 요소

segments.src: Analysts and investors are likely to focus on a handful of signals:
segments.tr: 분석가들과 투자자들은 몇 가지 신호에 집중할 것으로 보입니다.

segments.src: - **Capex guidance.** Did companies raise, hold or trim their spending plans for the coming year? A higher number can signal confidence in demand, but it can also raise worries about profit margins.
segments.tr: - **Capex 가이던스.** 기업들이 다가오는 해의 지출 계획을 상향, 유지, 또는 하향 조정했는가? 더 높은 수치는 수요에 대한 자신감을 나타낼 수 있지만, 이익률에 대한 우려를 낳을 수도 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Cloud growth.** Cloud divisions are where much of the AI demand shows up first. Faster growth, and commentary about backlogs of customer commitments, would suggest the infrastructure is being put to use.
segments.tr: - **클라우드 성장.** 클라우드 부문은 AI 수요의 대부분이 가장 먼저 나타나는 곳입니다. 더 빠른 성장과 고객 계약 잔고에 대한 언급은 인프라가 잘 활용되고 있음을 시사합니다.

segments.src: - **Capacity constraints.** Executives often say demand exceeds the computing capacity they can supply. If that remains true, it supports the case for continued building. If it fades, the tone may change.
segments.tr: - **용량 제약.** 경영진은 수요가 자신들이 공급할 수 있는 컴퓨팅 용량을 초과한다고 자주 말합니다. 이것이 계속 사실이라면 지속적인 구축을 뒷받침하는 근거가 됩니다. 이것이 옅어지면 분위기가 바뀔 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Margins and depreciation.** Servers and chips lose value over time, and that cost flows through the income statement as depreciation. Rising depreciation can weigh on profits even when revenue is growing.
segments.tr: - **이익률 및 감가상각.** 서버와 칩은 시간이 지남에 따라 가치를 잃으며, 그 비용은 감가상각비로 손익계산서에 반영됩니다. 감가상각비 증가가 매출이 증가하는 와중에도 이익을 압박할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: - **AI revenue disclosure.** Some companies share figures on AI-related products or customer usage. Any new detail on how many people and businesses are paying for these tools will be closely scrutinized.
segments.tr: - **AI 매출 공개.** 일부 기업은 AI 관련 제품이나 고객 사용량에 대한 수치를 공유합니다. 얼마나 많은 사람들과 기업이 이러한 도구에 비용을 지불하고 있는지에 대한 새로운 세부 정보는 면밀히 검토될 것입니다.

segments.src: - **Free cash flow.** When spending rises quickly, the cash left over after investment can shrink. Investors will check whether companies are funding the buildout from operations or leaning more on debt.
segments.tr: - **잉여현금흐름.** 지출이 빠르게 증가하면 투자 후 남는 현금이 줄어들 수 있습니다. 투자자들은 기업들이 영업 활동을 통해 구축 비용을 충당하고 있는지, 아니면 부채에 더 의존하고 있는지 확인할 것입니다.

segments.src: ## The case for patience
segments.tr: ## 인내심을 가져야 한다는 주장

segments.src: Supporters of the spending argue that large infrastructure cycles take time to mature.
segments.tr: 지출을 옹호하는 이들은 대규모 인프라 주기가 성숙하는 데는 시간이 걸린다고 주장합니다.

segments.src: Railroads, electric grids and the early internet all required heavy upfront investment before their economic benefits became clear.
segments.tr: 철도, 전력망, 초기의 인터넷 모두 경제적 혜택이 명확해지기 전에 막대한 선제적 투자가 필요했습니다.

segments.src: In this view, the companies building AI capacity today are positioning for a long period of growth, and falling behind could be costlier than overbuilding.
segments.tr: 이러한 관점에서 볼 때, 오늘날 AI 용량을 구축하는 기업들은 장기적인 성장의 기틀을 마련하고 있으며, 뒤처지는 것이 과잉 투자보다 더 큰 대가를 치를 수 있습니다.

segments.src: There is also evidence that businesses are experimenting widely with AI for coding assistance, customer service, document analysis and research.
segments.tr: 또한 기업들이 코딩 지원, 고객 서비스, 문서 분석 및 연구를 위해 AI를 광범위하게 실험하고 있다는 증거도 있습니다.

segments.src: If those pilots turn into everyday workflows, demand for computing power could keep rising.
segments.tr: 이러한 시범 사업이 일상적인 업무 흐름으로 전환된다면 컴퓨팅 파워에 대한 수요는 계속 증가할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The case for caution
segments.tr: ## 신중해야 한다는 주장

segments.src: Skeptics point out that spending is arriving faster than proven revenue.
segments.tr: 회의론자들은 입증된 매출보다 지출이 더 빠르게 실행되고 있다고 지적합니다.

segments.src: They note that some of the demand comes from a relatively small group of AI developers and that companies are, in part, selling to customers they also fund.
segments.tr: 이들은 수요의 일부가 비교적 소수의 AI 개발자 집단에서 나오며, 기업들이 부분적으로 자신들이 자금을 대는 고객에게 판매하고 있다고 말합니다.

segments.src: They also ask whether the pace of chip upgrades will make today's hardware obsolete sooner than expected, shortening the period in which it can earn a return.
segments.tr: 또한 칩 업그레이드 속도로 인해 오늘날의 하드웨어가 예상보다 일찍 구식화되어 수익을 창출할 수 있는 기간이 단축되는 것은 아닌지 묻습니다.

segments.src: Power supply is another constraint.
segments.tr: 전력 공급도 또 다른 제약 요소입니다.

segments.src: Data centers need large amounts of electricity, and delays in securing grid connections or equipment can slow projects and raise costs.
segments.tr: 데이터 센터는 막대한 양의 전력이 필요하며, 전력망 연결이나 장비 확보 지연으로 인해 프로젝트가 지연되고 비용이 상승할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: History offers a cautionary note: periods of enthusiastic building have sometimes been followed by corrections when expectations ran ahead of results.
segments.tr: 역사는 경고를 보냅니다. 열광적인 구축의 시기 뒤에는 기대가 결과보다 앞서 나갔을 때 조정을 겪곤 했습니다.

segments.src: Whether this cycle follows that path is exactly what investors are trying to judge.
segments.tr: 이번 주기가 그 길을 따를지 여부가 바로 투자자들이 판단하려고 애쓰는 부분입니다.

segments.src: ## Why it matters to everyday households
segments.tr: ## 일반 가계에도 중요한 이유

segments.src: Many people own these companies without realizing it.
segments.tr: 많은 사람들이 자기도 모르는 사이에 이들 기업의 주식을 소유하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Large technology firms make up a significant share of popular index funds, and those funds sit inside 401(k)s, IRAs and target-date retirement portfolios.
segments.tr: 대형 기술 기업들은 인기 있는 인덱스 펀드의 상당 부분을 차지하며, 이러한 펀드들은 401(k), IRA 및 타깃데이트 은퇴 포트폴리오에 들어있습니다.

segments.src: When a handful of companies move sharply, broad market indexes can move with them.
segments.tr: 소수의 기업이 크게 움직이면 광범위한 시장 지수도 함께 움직일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: The effects reach further than portfolios:
segments.tr: 그 영향은 포트폴리오 너머까지 미칩니다.

segments.src: - **Jobs and construction.** Data center projects support work in construction, electrical equipment and energy.
segments.tr: - **일자리 및 건설.** 데이터 센터 프로젝트는 건설, 전기 장비 및 에너지 분야의 일자리를 지원합니다.

segments.src: - **Utilities and electricity demand.** Growing computing needs are influencing power planning in some regions.
segments.tr: - **유틸리티 및 전력 수요.** 증가하는 컴퓨팅 요구사항은 일부 지역의 전력 계획에 영향을 미치고 있습니다.

segments.src: - **Business investment.** AI-related spending has become a noticeable contributor to overall corporate investment in the economy.
segments.tr: - **기업 투자.** AI 관련 지출은 경제 전체의 기업 투자에서 눈에 띄는 기여 요소가 되었습니다.

segments.src: - **Consumer products.** The tools built on this infrastructure are showing up in search, productivity software, phones and customer service.
segments.tr: - **소비자 제품.** 이 인프라 위에 구축된 도구들은 검색, 생산성 소프트웨어, 전화기 및 고객 서비스에 나타나고 있습니다.

segments.src: ## How to read the results
segments.tr: ## 실적 결과 해석법

segments.src: A few practical tips for following the news without getting lost in the noise:
segments.tr: 소음에 길을 잃지 않고 뉴스를 따라가기 위한 몇 가지 실용적인 팁은 다음과 같습니다.

segments.src: 1. **Compare spending to growth.** A big capex number means little without context. Look at it alongside cloud revenue growth and operating margins.
segments.tr: 1. **지출을 성장과 비교하세요.** 맥락이 없는 큰 capex 수치는 의미가 적습니다. 클라우드 매출 성장 및 영업이익률과 함께 살펴보세요.

segments.src: 2. **Listen to the tone on the call.** Language about demand, capacity and timelines often tells you more than a single figure.
segments.tr: 2. **실적 발표 통화의 뉘앙스에 귀를 기울이세요.** 수요, 용량, 일정에 관한 표현은 단일 수치보다 더 많은 것을 알려주는 경우가 많습니다.

segments.src: 3. **Remember that one quarter is a snapshot.** Infrastructure returns play out over years, and stock reactions on earnings day can be short-lived.
segments.tr: 3. **한 분기는 단면일 뿐이라는 점을 기억하세요.** 인프라 수익은 수년에 걸쳐 실현되며, 실적 발표 당일의 주가 반응은 단기에 그칠 수 있습니다.

segments.src: 4. **Mind your own concentration.** If much of your savings is tied to a few large technology names, it may be worth understanding how your funds are weighted.
segments.tr: 4. **자신의 자산 집중도를 신경 쓰세요.** 저축액의 상당 부분이 몇몇 대형 기술주에 묶여 있다면, 펀드의 비중이 어떻게 구성되어 있는지 이해할 가치가 있습니다.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 결론

segments.src: Next week's reports will not settle the debate over whether the AI buildout is a visionary investment or an overreach.
segments.tr: 다음 주 리포트가 AI 구축이 선견지명 있는 투자i인지 아니면 과도한 확장인지에 대한 논쟁을 종식시키지는 못할 것입니다.

segments.src: But they will add fresh evidence on both sides: how fast the spending is growing, how much customers are paying for it, and how comfortably companies can afford it.
segments.tr: 하지만 지출이 얼마나 빠르게 증가하고 있는지, 고객이 이에 얼마나 비용을 지불하고 있는지, 기업이 이를 얼마나 여유롭게 감당할 수 있는지 등 양측 모두에 새로운 증거를 더해줄 것입니다.

segments.src: For investors and savers alike, the receipt for the AI boom is starting to come into view.
segments.tr: 투자자와 저축가 모두에게 AI 붐에 대한 영수증이 점차 모습을 드러내고 있습니다.

segments.src: How it reads may shape markets well into the new year.
segments.tr: 그 내용이 어떻게 읽히느냐에 따라 새해까지 시장의 향방이 결정될 수 있습니다.

segments.tr: *본 기사는 일반적인 정보 제공을 위한 것이며 투자 자문을 구성하지 않습니다.

zh.title: 人工智能支出账单：下周科技巨头的财报将如何揭示万亿美元的赌局

segments.src: Over the next several days, some of the largest technology companies in the world will open their books for the latest quarter.
segments.tr: 在接下来的几天里，全球一些最大的科技公司将公布其最新季度的财务报表。

segments.src: Revenue and profit will get the headlines, as they always do.
segments.tr: 营收和利润将像往常一样占据头条新闻。

segments.src: But this earnings season, the number many investors care about most sits a little further down the page: **how much these companies are spending on chips and data centers, and whether that spending is beginning to pay off.**
segments.tr: 但在本财报季，许多投资者最关心的数字却在页面的更下方：**这些公司在芯片和数据中心上花费了多少，以及这些支出是否开始得到回报。**

segments.src: That question matters well beyond Wall Street.
segments.tr: 这个问题的重要性远远超出了华尔街。

segments.src: The answer can influence tech stock prices, the value of retirement accounts that hold them, and the pace of the broader economy.
segments.tr: 答案可能会影响科技股价格、持有这些股票的退休账户的价值，以及更广泛的经济增速。

segments.src: ## Why this earnings season is different
segments.tr: ## 为什么这个财报季与众不同

segments.src: For years, big tech earnings followed a familiar script: advertising, cloud subscriptions, devices and software.
segments.tr: 多年来，大型科技公司的财报遵循着熟悉的剧本：广告、云订阅、设备和软件。

segments.src: Since the rise of generative artificial intelligence, a new line item has taken center stage.
segments.tr: 自从生成式人工智能兴起以来，一个新的项目占据了中心舞台。

segments.src: **Capital expenditures**, often shortened to "capex," refers to money spent on long-lived assets such as data centers, servers, networking gear and specialized AI chips.
segments.tr: **资本支出**（通常简称为“capex”），指的是花在长寿命资产上的资金，例如数据中心、服务器、网络设备和专门的AI芯片。

segments.src: Across the industry, the combined capex plans of the largest cloud and platform companies have climbed to levels that analysts often describe in the hundreds of billions of dollars per year.
segments.tr: 在整个行业中，最大的云平台和平台公司合并后的资本支出计划已经攀升至分析师经常用每年数千亿美元来形容的水平。

segments.src: Taken together with commitments over several years, the total is frequently framed as a trillion-dollar bet that AI will become a core part of how people and businesses work.
segments.tr: 结合多年来的承诺，总额经常被描述为一项万亿美元的赌局，即人工智能将成为人们和企业工作方式的核心部分。

segments.src: A bet that large raises an obvious question: where is the return?
segments.tr: 如此巨大的赌局提出了一个显而易见的问题：回报在哪里？

segments.src: ## What investors will be watching
segments.tr: ## 投资者将关注什么

segments.src: Analysts and investors are likely to focus on a handful of signals:
segments.tr: 分析师和投资者可能会关注以下几个信号：

segments.src: - **Capex guidance.** Did companies raise, hold or trim their spending plans for the coming year? A higher number can signal confidence in demand, but it can also raise worries about profit margins.
segments.tr: - **资本支出指引。** 公司是否提高、保持或削减了来年的支出计划？更高的数字可能表明对需求的信心，但也可能引发对利润率的担忧。

segments.src: - **Cloud growth.** Cloud divisions are where much of the AI demand shows up first. Faster growth, and commentary about backlogs of customer commitments, would suggest the infrastructure is being put to use.
segments.tr: - **云业务增长。** 云业务部门是大部分AI需求首先显现的地方。更快的增长，以及关于客户承诺积压的评论，将表明基础设施正在投入使用。

segments.src: - **Capacity constraints.** Executives often say demand exceeds the computing capacity they can supply. If that remains true, it supports the case for continued building. If it fades, the tone may change.
segments.tr: - **产能限制。** 高管们经常表示，需求超过了他们能供应的计算能力。如果情况依然如此，这就支持了继续建设的理由。如果这种趋势消退，基调可能会改变。

segments.src: - **Margins and depreciation.** Servers and chips lose value over time, and that cost flows through the income statement as depreciation. Rising depreciation can weigh on profits even when revenue is growing.
segments.tr: - **利润率与折旧。** 服务器和芯片随着时间的推移会贬值，这笔成本作为折旧计入利润表。即使营收在增长，不断上升的折旧也会对利润造成压力。

segments.src: - **AI revenue disclosure.** Some companies share figures on AI-related products or customer usage. Any new detail on how many people and businesses are paying for these tools will be closely scrutinized.
segments.tr: - **AI营收披露。** 一些公司分享了有关AI相关产品或客户使用的数字。关于有多少人和企业在为这些工具付费的任何新细节都将受到密切审视。

segments.src: - **Free cash flow.** When spending rises quickly, the cash left over after investment can shrink. Investors will check whether companies are funding the buildout from operations or leaning more on debt.
segments.tr: - **自由现金流。** 当支出迅速增长时，投资后剩余的现金可能会缩水。投资者将检查公司是通过运营来资助建设还是更多地依赖债务。

segments.src: ## The case for patience
segments.tr: ## 耐心的理由

segments.src: Supporters of the spending argue that large infrastructure cycles take time to mature.
segments.tr: 支出的支持者认为，大型基础设施周期需要时间来成熟。

segments.src: Railroads, electric grids and the early internet all required heavy upfront investment before their economic benefits became clear.
segments.tr: 铁路、电网和早期的互联网都需要大量的初期投资，然后它们的经济效益才变得清晰起来。

segments.src: In this view, the companies building AI capacity today are positioning for a long period of growth, and falling behind could be costlier than overbuilding.
segments.tr: 在这种观点看来，今天建设AI产能的公司正在为漫长的增长期做准备，而落后的代价可能比过度建设更高。

segments.src: There is also evidence that businesses are experimenting widely with AI for coding assistance, customer service, document analysis and research.
segments.tr: 也有证据表明，企业正在广泛试验AI以用于代码辅助、客户服务、文档分析和研究。

segments.src: If those pilots turn into everyday workflows, demand for computing power could keep rising.
segments.tr: 如果这些试点转变为日常工作流程，对计算能力的需求可能会继续上升。

segments.src: ## The case for caution
segments.tr: ## 谨慎的理由

segments.src: Skeptics point out that spending is arriving faster than proven revenue.
segments.tr: 怀疑论者指出，支出的到来速度快于已被证实的营收。

segments.src: They note that some of the demand comes from a relatively small group of AI developers and that companies are, in part, selling to customers they also fund.
segments.tr: 他们指出，部分需求来自相对小的一群AI开发者，而且公司在某种程度上是在向他们也资助的客户销售产品。

segments.src: They also ask whether the pace of chip upgrades will make today's hardware obsolete sooner than expected, shortening the period in which it can earn a return.
segments.tr: 他们还质疑，芯片升级的速度是否会比预期更快地使今天的硬件过时，从而缩短其获得回报的期限。

segments.src: Power supply is another constraint.
segments.tr: 电力供应是另一个制约因素。

segments.src: Data centers need large amounts of electricity, and delays in securing grid connections or equipment can slow projects and raise costs.
segments.tr: 数据中心需要大量的电力，而获得电网连接或设备的延误可能会放慢项目进度并增加成本。

segments.src: History offers a cautionary note: periods of enthusiastic building have sometimes been followed by corrections when expectations ran ahead of results.
segments.tr: 历史提供了一个警示：当期望跑在结果前面时，热情的建设期有时会伴随着调整。

segments.src: Whether this cycle follows that path is exactly what investors are trying to judge.
segments.tr: 这个周期是否会遵循这条道路，正是投资者试图判断的。

segments.src: ## Why it matters to everyday households
segments.tr: ## 为什么这对普通家庭很重要

segments.src: Many people own these companies without realizing it.
segments.tr: 许多人在没有意识到这一点的情况下拥有这些公司。

segments.src: Large technology firms make up a significant share of popular index funds, and those funds sit inside 401(k)s, IRAs and target-date retirement portfolios.
segments.tr: 大型科技公司占热门指数基金的很大一部分，而这些基金存在于401(k)、IRA和目标日期退休投资组合中。

segments.src: When a handful of companies move sharply, broad market indexes can move with them.
segments.tr: 当少数公司出现剧烈波动时，广泛的市场指数也可能随之波动。

segments.src: The effects reach further than portfolios:
segments.tr: 这些影响超出了投资组合的范畴：

segments.src: - **Jobs and construction.** Data center projects support work in construction, electrical equipment and energy.
segments.tr: - **就业与建筑。** 数据中心项目支持建筑、电气设备和能源方面的工作。

segments.src: - **Utilities and electricity demand.** Growing computing needs are influencing power planning in some regions.
segments.tr: - **公用事业与电力需求。** 不断增长的计算需求正在影响某些地区的电力规划。

segments.src: - **Business investment.** AI-related spending has become a noticeable contributor to overall corporate investment in the economy.
segments.tr: - **企业投资。** 与AI相关的支出已成为经济中总体企业投资的一个引人注目的贡献者。

segments.src: - **Consumer products.** The tools built on this infrastructure are showing up in search, productivity software, phones and customer service.
segments.tr: - **消费产品。** 建立在这个基础设施之上的工具正出现在搜索、生产力软件、手机和客户服务中。

segments.src: ## How to read the results
segments.tr: ## 如何解读财报结果

segments.src: A few practical tips for following the news without getting lost in the noise:
segments.tr: 一些实用的建议，帮助你在关注新闻时不会迷失在噪音中：

segments.src: 1. **Compare spending to growth.** A big capex number means little without context. Look at it alongside cloud revenue growth and operating margins.
segments.tr: 1. **将支出与增长进行比较。** 没有背景信息，一个庞大的资本支出数字意义不大。要把它与云业务营收增长和营业利润率结合起来看。

segments.src: 2. **Listen to the tone on the call.** Language about demand, capacity and timelines often tells you more than a single figure.
segments.tr: 2. **倾听电话会议上的基调。** 关于需求、产能和时间表的语言往往比单一数字更能告诉你更多信息。

segments.src: 3. **Remember that one quarter is a snapshot.** Infrastructure returns play out over years, and stock reactions on earnings day can be short-lived.
segments.tr: 3. **记住一个季度只是一个快照。** 基础设施的回报需要数年时间才能显现，财报日的股票反应可能是短暂的。

segments.src: 4. **Mind your own concentration.** If much of your savings is tied to a few large technology names, it may be worth understanding how your funds are weighted.
segments.tr: 4. **注意你自己的集中度。** 如果你的大部分储蓄都绑定在几家大型科技股上，了解你的基金是如何加权的可能是值得的。

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## 底线

segments.src: Next week's reports will not settle the debate over whether the AI buildout is a visionary investment or an overreach.
segments.tr: 下周的报告不会解决关于AI建设是远见卓识的投资还是过度延伸的争论。

segments.src: But they will add fresh evidence on both sides: how fast the spending is growing, how much customers are paying for it, and how comfortably companies can afford it.
segments.tr: 但它们将为双方增加新的证据：支出的增长速度有多快，客户为之支付了多少费用，以及公司能够多么舒适地负担得起。

segments.src: For investors and savers alike, the receipt for the AI boom is starting to come into view.
segments.tr: 对于投资者和储户来说，人工智能热潮的账单开始显现。

segments.src: How it reads may shape markets well into the new year.
segments.tr: 它的解读方式可能会塑造一直延续到新年的市场。

segments.tr: *本文仅供一般参考，不构成投资建议。

segments.src: Market conditions change quickly; consider consulting a qualified financial professional about your own situation.*
segments.tr: 市场状况瞬息万变；请考虑就您自己的情况咨询合格的金融专业人士。*

hi.title: AI खर्च की रसीद: अगले हफ्ते बिग टेक की कमाई से एक खरब डॉलर के दांव के बारे में क्या पता चलेगा

segments.src: Over the next several days, some of the largest technology companies in the world will open their books for the latest quarter.
segments.tr: आने वाले कुछ दिनों में, दुनिया की कुछ सबसे बड़ी तकनीकी कंपनियां नवीनतम तिमाही के लिए अपनी किताबें खोलेंगी।

segments.src: Revenue and profit will get the headlines, as they always do.
segments.tr: राजस्व और लाभ हमेशा की तरह सुर्खियाँ बटोरेंगे।

segments.src: But this earnings season, the number many investors care about most sits a little further down the page: **how much these companies are spending on chips and data centers, and whether that spending is beginning to pay off.**
segments.tr: लेकिन इस कमाई के सीजन में, जिस आंकड़े की परवाह कई निवेशकों को सबसे ज्यादा है, वह पेज पर थोड़ा नीचे है: **ये कंपनियां चिप्स और डेटा सेंटर पर कितना खर्च कर रही हैं, और क्या वह खर्च रंग लाना शुरू कर रहा है।**

segments.src: That question matters well beyond Wall Street.
segments.tr: यह सवाल वॉल स्ट्रीट से बहुत आगे तक मायने रखता है।

segments.src: The answer can influence tech stock prices, the value of retirement accounts that hold them, and the pace of the broader economy.
segments.tr: इसका जवाब टेक स्टॉक की कीमतों, उन्हें रखने वाले रिटायरमेंट खातों के मूल्य और व्यापक अर्थव्यवस्था की गति को प्रभावित कर सकता है।

segments.src: ## Why this earnings season is different
segments.tr: ## यह कमाई का सीजन अलग क्यों है

segments.src: For years, big tech earnings followed a familiar script: advertising, cloud subscriptions, devices and software.
segments.tr: सालों से, बिग टेक की कमाई ने एक जाने-पहचाने नुस्खे का पालन किया: विज्ञापन, क्लाउड सब्सक्रिप्शन, डिवाइस और सॉफ्टवेयर।

segments.src: Since the rise of generative artificial intelligence, a new line item has taken center stage.
segments.tr: जेनरेटिव आर्टिफिशियल इंटेलिजेंस के उदय के बाद से, एक नई लाइन आइटम ने केंद्र चरण ले लिया है।

segments.src: **Capital expenditures**, often shortened to "capex," refers to money spent on long-lived assets such as data centers, servers, networking gear and specialized AI chips.
segments.tr: **पूंजीगत व्यय (Capital expenditures)**, जिसे अक्सर "capex" कहा जाता है, डेटा सेंटर, सर्वर, नेटवर्किंग गियर और विशेष AI चिप्स जैसी लंबे समय तक टिकने वाली संपत्तियों पर खर्च किए गए धन को संदर्भित करता है।

segments.src: Across the industry, the combined capex plans of the largest cloud and platform companies have climbed to levels that analysts often describe in the hundreds of billions of dollars per year.
segments.tr: पूरे उद्योग में, सबसे बड़ी क्लाउड और प्लेटफ़ॉर्म कंपनियों की संयुक्त capex योजनाएं उन स्तरों तक चढ़ गई हैं जिन्हें विश्लेषक अक्सर प्रति वर्ष सैकड़ों अरब डॉलर में वर्णित करते हैं।

segments.src: Taken together with commitments over several years, the total is frequently framed as a trillion-dollar bet that AI will become a core part of how people and businesses work.
segments.tr: कई वर्षों की प्रतिबद्धताओं के साथ मिलकर, कुल को अक्सर एक खरब डॉलर के दांव के रूप में तैयार किया जाता है कि AI इस बात का एक केंद्रीय हिस्सा बन जाएगा कि लोग और व्यवसाय कैसे काम करते हैं।

segments.src: A bet that large raises an obvious question: where is the return?
segments.tr: इतना बड़ा दांव एक स्पष्ट सवाल उठाता है: रिटर्न कहाँ है?

segments.src: ## What investors will be watching
segments.tr: ## निवेशक क्या देख रहे होंगे

segments.src: Analysts and investors are likely to focus on a handful of signals:
segments.tr: विश्लेषक और निवेशक मुट्ठी भर संकेतों पर ध्यान केंद्रित करने की संभावना रखते हैं:

segments.src: - **Capex guidance.** Did companies raise, hold or trim their spending plans for the coming year? A higher number can signal confidence in demand, but it can also raise worries about profit margins.
segments.tr: - **Capex मार्गदर्शन।** क्या कंपनियों ने आने वाले वर्ष के लिए अपनी खर्च योजनाओं को बढ़ाया, बरकरार रखा या कम किया? एक उच्च संख्या मांग में विश्वास का संकेत दे सकती है, लेकिन यह लाभ मार्जिन के बारे में चिंताएं भी बढ़ा सकती है।

segments.src: - **Cloud growth.** Cloud divisions are where much of the AI demand shows up first. Faster growth, and commentary about backlogs of customer commitments, would suggest the infrastructure is being put to use.
segments.tr: - **क्लाउड वृद्धि।** क्लाउड डिवीजनों में AI की मांग सबसे पहले दिखाई देती है। तेजी से वृद्धि, और ग्राहक प्रतिबद्धताओं के बैकलॉग के बारे में टिप्पणी, यह सुझाव देगी कि बुनियादी ढांचे का उपयोग किया जा रहा है।

segments.src: - **Capacity constraints.** Executives often say demand exceeds the computing capacity they can supply. If that remains true, it supports the case for continued building. If it fades, the tone may change.
segments.tr: - **क्षमता की बाधाएं।** कार्यकारी अधिकारी अक्सर कहते हैं कि मांग उस कंप्यूटिंग क्षमता से अधिक है जिसे वे आपूर्ति कर सकते हैं। यदि यह सच रहता है, तो यह निरंतर निर्माण के मामले का समर्थन करता है। यदि यह फीका पड़ता है, तो स्वर बदल सकता है।

segments.src: - **Margins and depreciation.** Servers and chips lose value over time, and that cost flows through the income statement as depreciation. Rising depreciation can weigh on profits even when revenue is growing.
segments.tr: - **मार्जिन और मूल्यह्रास।** सर्वर और चिप्स समय के साथ मूल्य खो देते हैं, और वह लागत मूल्यह्रास के रूप में आय विवरण के माध्यम से प्रवाहित होती है। राजस्व बढ़ने पर भी बढ़ता मूल्यह्रास मुनाफे पर भारी पड़ सकता है।

segments.src: - **AI revenue disclosure.** Some companies share figures on AI-related products or customer usage. Any new detail on how many people and businesses are paying for these tools will be closely scrutinized.
segments.tr: - **AI राजस्व खुलासा।** कुछ कंपनियां AI से संबंधित उत्पादों या ग्राहकों के उपयोग पर आंकड़े साझा करती हैं। कितने लोग और व्यवसाय इन टूल के लिए भुगतान कर रहे हैं, इस पर कोई भी नया विवरण बारीकी से जांचा जाएगा।

segments.src: - **Free cash flow.** When spending rises quickly, the cash left over after investment can shrink. Investors will check whether companies are funding the buildout from operations or leaning more on debt.
segments.tr: - **फ्री कैश फ्लो।** जब खर्च तेजी से बढ़ता है, तो निवेश के बाद बचा हुआ नकदी सिकुड़ सकता है। निवेशक जांच करेंगे कि क्या कंपनियां संचालन से निर्माण को वित्तपोषित कर रही हैं या ऋण पर अधिक निर्भर हैं।

segments.src: ## The case for patience
segments.tr: ## धैर्य का मामला

segments.src: Supporters of the spending argue that large infrastructure cycles take time to mature.
segments.tr: खर्च के समर्थकों का तर्क है कि बड़े बुनियादी ढांचा चक्रों को परिपक्व होने में समय लगता है।

segments.src: Railroads, electric grids and the early internet all required heavy upfront investment before their economic benefits became clear.
segments.tr: रेलवे, बिजली ग्रिड और शुरुआती इंटरनेट सभी को अपने आर्थिक लाभ स्पष्ट होने से पहले भारी अग्रिम निवेश की आवश्यकता थी।

segments.src: In this view, the companies building AI capacity today are positioning for a long period of growth, and falling behind could be costlier than overbuilding.
segments.tr: इस दृष्टिकोण में, आज AI क्षमता का निर्माण करने वाली कंपनियां विकास की लंबी अवधि के लिए स्थिति बना रही हैं, और पीछे रहना अधिक निर्माण करने की तुलना में अधिक महंगा हो सकता है।

segments.src: There is also evidence that businesses are experimenting widely with AI for coding assistance, customer service, document analysis and research.
segments.tr: इस बात के भी प्रमाण हैं कि व्यवसाय कोडिंग सहायता, ग्राहक सेवा, दस्तावेज़ विश्लेषण और अनुसंधान के लिए AI के साथ व्यापक रूप से प्रयोग कर रहे हैं।

segments.src: If those pilots turn into everyday workflows, demand for computing power could keep rising.
segments.tr: यदि वे पायलट रोजमर्रा के वर्कफ़्लो में बदल जाते हैं, तो कंप्यूटिंग शक्ति की मांग बढ़ती रह सकती है।

segments.src: ## The case for caution
segments.tr: ## सावधानी का मामला

segments.src: Skeptics point out that spending is arriving faster than proven revenue.

segments.src: They note that some of the demand comes from a relatively small group of AI developers and that companies are, in part, selling to customers they also fund.

segments.src: They also ask whether the pace of chip upgrades will make today's hardware obsolete sooner than expected, shortening the period in which it can earn a return.
segments.tr: वे यह भी पूछते हैं कि क्या चिप अपग्रेड की गति आज के हार्डवेयर को उम्मीद से पहले पुराना कर देगी, जिससे वह अवधि कम हो जाएगी जिसमें यह रिटर्न अर्जित कर सकता है।

segments.src: ## Why it matters to everyday households
segments.tr: ## रोजमर्रा के परिवारों के लिए यह क्यों मायने रखता है

segments.src: Many people own these companies without realizing it.
segments.tr: कई लोग इसे महसूस किए बिना इन कंपनियों के मालिक हैं।

segments.src: Large technology firms make up a significant share of popular index funds, and those funds sit inside 401(k)s, IRAs and target-date retirement portfolios.
segments.tr: बड़ी तकनीकी फर्म लोकप्रिय इंडेक्स फंडों का एक महत्वपूर्ण हिस्सा बनाती हैं, और वे फंड 401(k)s, IRAs और टारगेट-डेट रिटायरमेंट पोर्टफोलियो के अंदर बैठते हैं।

segments.src: When a handful of companies move sharply, broad market indexes can move with them.
segments.tr: जब मुट्ठी भर कंपनियां तेजी से चलती हैं, तो व्यापक बाजार सूचकांक उनके साथ आगे बढ़ सकते हैं।

segments.src: The effects reach further than portfolios:
segments.tr: प्रभाव पोर्टफोलियो से आगे तक पहुँचते हैं:

segments.src: - **Jobs and construction.** Data center projects support work in construction, electrical equipment and energy.
segments.tr: - **नौकरियां और निर्माण।** डेटा सेंटर परियोजनाएं निर्माण, विद्युत उपकरण और ऊर्जा में काम का समर्थन करती हैं।

segments.src: - **Utilities and electricity demand.** Growing computing needs are influencing power planning in some regions.
segments.tr: - **उपयोगिताएँ और बिजली की मांग।** बढ़ती कंप्यूटिंग ज़रूरतें कुछ क्षेत्रों में बिजली की योजना को प्रभावित कर रही हैं।

segments.src: - **Business investment.** AI-related spending has become a noticeable contributor to overall corporate investment in the economy.
segments.tr: - **व्यापार निवेश।** AI से संबंधित खर्च अर्थव्यवस्था में कुल कॉर्पोरेट निवेश में एक ध्यान देने योग्य योगदानकर्ता बन गया है।

segments.src: - **Consumer products.** The tools built on this infrastructure are showing up in search, productivity software, phones and customer service.
segments.tr: - **उपभोक्ता उत्पाद।** इस बुनियादी ढांचे पर बने टूल खोज, उत्पादकता सॉफ्टवेयर, फोन और ग्राहक सेवा में दिखाई दे रहे हैं।

segments.src: ## How to read the results
segments.tr: ## परिणामों को कैसे पढ़ें

segments.src: A few practical tips for following the news without getting lost in the noise:
segments.tr: शोरगुल में खोए बिना समाचारों का अनुसरण करने के लिए कुछ व्यावहारिक सुझाव:

segments.src: 1. **Compare spending to growth.** A big capex number means little without context. Look at it alongside cloud revenue growth and operating margins.
segments.tr: 1. **विकास के साथ खर्च की तुलना करें।** संदर्भ के बिना एक बड़ा capex नंबर बहुत कम मायने रखता है। क्लाउड राजस्व वृद्धि और ऑपरेटिंग मार्जिन के साथ इसे देखें।

segments.src: 2. **Listen to the tone on the call.** Language about demand, capacity and timelines often tells you more than a single figure.
segments.tr: 2. **कॉल पर टोन सुनें।** मांग, क्षमता और समयसीमा के बारे में भाषा अक्सर आपको एक आंकड़े से अधिक बताती है।

segments.src: 3. **Remember that one quarter is a snapshot.** Infrastructure returns play out over years, and stock reactions on earnings day can be short-lived.
segments.tr: 3. **याद रखें कि एक तिमाही एक स्नैपशॉट है।** बुनियादी ढांचे का रिटर्न वर्षों में सामने आता है, और कमाई के दिन स्टॉक की प्रतिक्रियाएं अल्पकालिक हो सकती हैं।

segments.src: 4. **Mind your own concentration.** If much of your savings is tied to a few large technology names, it may be worth understanding how your funds are weighted.
segments.tr: 4. **अपने स्वयं के एकाग्रता का ध्यान रखें।** यदि आपकी अधिकांश बचत कुछ बड़े तकनीकी नामों से जुड़ी है, तो यह समझनावर्थ हो सकता है कि आपके फंड कैसे भारित हैं।

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## निचला रेखा

segments.tr: अगले सप्ताह की रिपोर्ट इस बहस को तय नहीं करेगी कि AI निर्माण एक दूरदर्शी निवेश है या अतिरेक।

segments.src: But they will add fresh evidence on both sides: how fast the spending is growing, how much customers are paying for it, and how comfortably companies can afford it.

es.title: El recibo del gasto en IA: lo que revelarán los resultados de las grandes tecnológicas la próxima semana sobre una apuesta de un billón de dólares

segments.src: Over the next several days, some of the largest technology companies in the world will open their books for the latest quarter.
segments.tr: Durante los próximos días, algunas de las empresas tecnológicas más grandes del mundo abrirán sus libros para el último trimestre.

segments.src: Revenue and profit will get the headlines, as they always do.
segments.tr: Los ingresos y los beneficios acapararán los titulares, como siempre lo hacen.

segments.src: But this earnings season, the number many investors care about most sits a little further down the page: **how much these companies are spending on chips and data centers, and whether that spending is beginning to pay off.**
segments.tr: Pero en esta temporada de resultados, la cifra que más importa a muchos inversores se encuentra un poco más abajo en la página: **cuánto están gastando estas empresas en chips y centros de datos, y si ese gasto está empezando a dar sus frutos.**

segments.src: That question matters well beyond Wall Street.
segments.tr: Esa pregunta es importante mucho más allá de Wall Street.

segments.src: The answer can influence tech stock prices, the value of retirement accounts that hold them, and the pace of the broader economy.
segments.tr: La respuesta puede influir en los precios de las acciones tecnológicas, el valor de las cuentas de jubilación que las contienen y el ritmo de la economía en general.

segments.src: ## Why this earnings season is different
segments.tr: ## Por qué esta temporada de resultados es diferente

segments.src: For years, big tech earnings followed a familiar script: advertising, cloud subscriptions, devices and software.
segments.tr: Durante años, los resultados de las grandes tecnológicas siguieron un guion familiar: publicidad, suscripciones a la nube, dispositivos y software.

segments.src: Since the rise of generative artificial intelligence, a new line item has taken center stage.
segments.tr: Desde el auge de la inteligencia artificial generativa, una nueva partida ha ocupado un lugar central.

segments.src: **Capital expenditures**, often shortened to "capex," refers to money spent on long-lived assets such as data centers, servers, networking gear and specialized AI chips.
segments.tr: **Los gastos de capital**, a menudo abreviados como "capex", se refieren al dinero gastado en activos de larga duración, como centros de datos, servidores, equipos de red y chips de IA especializados.

segments.src: Across the industry, the combined capex plans of the largest cloud and platform companies have climbed to levels that analysts often describe in the hundreds of billions of dollars per year.
segments.tr: En toda la industria, los planes de gasto de capital combinados de las empresas de nube y plataformas más grandes han subido a niveles que los analistas suelen describir en cientos de miles de millones de dólares por año.

segments.src: Taken together with commitments over several years, the total is frequently framed as a trillion-dollar bet that AI will become a core part of how people and businesses work.
segments.tr: Tomados en conjunto con los compromisos a lo largo de varios años, el total se enmarca frecuentemente como una apuesta de un billón de dólares a que la IA se convertirá en una parte fundamental de cómo trabajan las personas y las empresas.

segments.src: A bet that large raises an obvious question: where is the return?
segments.tr: Una apuesta tan grande plantea una pregunta obvia: ¿dónde está el retorno?

segments.src: ## What investors will be watching
segments.tr: ## Qué estarán observando los inversores

segments.src: Analysts and investors are likely to focus on a handful of signals:
segments.tr: Es probable que los analistas e inversores se centren en un puñado de señales:

segments.src: - **Capex guidance.** Did companies raise, hold or trim their spending plans for the coming year? A higher number can signal confidence in demand, but it can also raise worries about profit margins.
segments.tr: - **Guía de gasto de capital (Capex).** ¿Las empresas aumentaron, mantuvieron o recortaron sus planes de gasto para el próximo año? Una cifra más alta puede indicar confianza en la demanda, pero también puede generar preocupaciones sobre los márgenes de beneficio.

segments.src: - **Cloud growth.** Cloud divisions are where much of the AI demand shows up first. Faster growth, and commentary about backlogs of customer commitments, would suggest the infrastructure is being put to use.
segments.tr: - **Crecimiento de la nube.** Las divisiones de nube son donde gran parte de la demanda de IA aparece primero. Un crecimiento más rápido, y los comentarios sobre los retrasos en los compromisos de los clientes, sugerirían que la infraestructura se está poniendo en uso.

segments.src: - **Capacity constraints.** Executives often say demand exceeds the computing capacity they can supply. If that remains true, it supports the case for continued building. If it fades, the tone may change.
segments.tr: - **Restricciones de capacidad.** Los ejecutivos a menudo dicen que la demanda supera la capacidad informática que pueden suministrar. Si eso sigue siendo cierto, respalda el caso de una construcción continua. Si se desvanece, el tono puede cambiar.

segments.src: - **Margins and depreciation.** Servers and chips lose value over time, and that cost flows through the income statement as depreciation. Rising depreciation can weigh on profits even when revenue is growing.
segments.tr: - **Márgenes y depreciación.** Los servidores y los chips pierden valor con el tiempo, y ese costo fluye a través del estado de resultados como depreciación. El aumento de la depreciación puede afectar los beneficios incluso cuando los ingresos están creciendo.

segments.src: - **AI revenue disclosure.** Some companies share figures on AI-related products or customer usage. Any new detail on how many people and businesses are paying for these tools will be closely scrutinized.
segments.tr: - **Divulgación de ingresos por IA.** Algunas empresas comparten cifras sobre productos relacionados con la IA o el uso de los clientes. Cualquier nuevo detalle sobre cuántas personas y empresas están pagando por estas herramientas será examinado de cerca.

segments.src: - **Free cash flow.** When spending rises quickly, the cash left over after investment can shrink. Investors will check whether companies are funding the buildout from operations or leaning more on debt.
segments.tr: - **Flujo de caja libre.** Cuando el gasto aumenta rápidamente, el efectivo que queda después de la inversión puede reducirse. Los inversores comprobarán si las empresas están financiando la expansión a partir de las operaciones o dependiendo más de la deuda.

segments.src: ## The case for patience
segments.tr: ## El argumento a favor de la paciencia

segments.src: Supporters of the spending argue that large infrastructure cycles take time to mature.
segments.tr: Los defensores del gasto argumentan que los grandes ciclos de infraestructura tardan tiempo en madurar.

segments.src: Railroads, electric grids and the early internet all required heavy upfront investment before their economic benefits became clear.
segments.tr: Los ferrocarriles, las redes eléctricas y los inicios de Internet requirieron una fuerte inversión inicial antes de que sus beneficios económicos quedaran claros.

segments.src: In this view, the companies building AI capacity today are positioning for a long period of growth, and falling behind could be costlier than overbuilding.
segments.tr: Desde este punto de vista, las empresas que construyen capacidad de IA hoy se están posicionando para un largo período de crecimiento, y quedarse atrás podría ser más costoso que construir en exceso.

segments.src: There is also evidence that businesses are experimenting widely with AI for coding assistance, customer service, document analysis and research.
segments.tr: También hay evidencia de que las empresas están experimentando ampliamente con la IA para asistencia en codificación, servicio al cliente, análisis de documentos e investigación.

segments.src: If those pilots turn into everyday workflows, demand for computing power could keep rising.
segments.tr: Si esos proyectos piloto se convierten en flujos de trabajo cotidianos, la demanda de potencia informática podría seguir aumentando.

segments.src: ## The case for caution
segments.tr: ## El argumento a favor de la cautela

segments.src: Skeptics point out that spending is arriving faster than proven revenue.
segments.tr: Los escépticos señalan que el gasto está llegando más rápido que los ingresos probados.

segments.src: They note that some of the demand comes from a relatively small group of AI developers and that companies are, in part, selling to customers they also fund.
segments.tr: Observan que parte de la demanda proviene de un grupo relativamente pequeño de desarrolladores de IA y que las empresas, en parte, están vendiendo a clientes a los que también financian.

segments.src: They also ask whether the pace of chip upgrades will make today's hardware obsolete sooner than expected, shortening the period in which it can earn a return.
segments.tr: También se preguntan si el ritmo de las actualizaciones de chips hará que el hardware actual quede obsoleto antes de lo esperado, acortando el período en el que puede generar un retorno.

segments.src: Power supply is another constraint.
segments.tr: El suministro de energía es otra limitación.

segments.src: Data centers need large amounts of electricity, and delays in securing grid connections or equipment can slow projects and raise costs.
segments.tr: Los centros de datos necesitan grandes cantidades de electricidad, y los retrasos en la obtención de conexiones a la red o equipos pueden ralentizar los proyectos y aumentar los costos.

segments.src: History offers a cautionary note: periods of enthusiastic building have sometimes been followed by corrections when expectations ran ahead of results.
segments.tr: La historia ofrece una nota de advertencia: los períodos de construcción entusiasta a veces han sido seguidos por correcciones cuando las expectativas se adelantaron a los resultados.

segments.src: Whether this cycle follows that path is exactly what investors are trying to judge.
segments.tr: Si este ciclo sigue ese camino es exactamente lo que los inversores están tratando de juzgar.

segments.tr: - **Empleos y construcción.** Los proyectos de centros de datos apoyan el trabajo en la construcción, equipos eléctricos y energía.

segments.tr: - **Servicios públicos y demanda de electricidad.** Las crecientes necesidades informáticas están influyendo en la planificación energética en algunas regiones.

segments.tr: - **Productos de consumo.** Las herramientas construidas sobre esta infraestructura están apareciendo en búsquedas, software de productividad, teléfonos y servicio al cliente.

segments.src: ## How to read the results
segments.tr: ## Cómo leer los resultados

segments.tr: Algunos consejos prácticos para seguir las noticias sin perderse en el ruido:

segments.tr: 1. **Compare el gasto con el crecimiento.** Una gran cifra de gasto de capital significa poco sin contexto. Mírela junto con el crecimiento de los ingresos de la nube y los márgenes operativos.

segments.tr: 2. **Escuche el tono en la llamada.** El lenguaje sobre la demanda, la capacidad y los plazos a menudo le dice más que una sola cifra.

segments.src: 3. **Remember that one quarter is a snapshot.** Infrastructure returns play out over years, and stock reactions on earnings day can be short-lived.

segments.src: 4. **Mind your own concentration.** If much of your savings is tied to a few large technology names, it may be worth understanding how your funds are weighted.
segments.tr: 4. **Tenga en cuenta su propia concentración.** Si gran parte de sus ahorros está vinculada a unos pocos grandes nombres tecnológicos, puede valer la pena entender cómo están ponderados sus fondos.

ar.title: إيصال إنفاق الذكاء الاصطناعي: ما ستكشفه أرباح شركات التكنولوجيا الكبرى الأسبوع المقبل حول رهان بقيمة تريليون دولار

segments.src: Over the next several days, some of the largest technology companies in the world will open their books for the latest quarter.
segments.tr: على مدى الأيام القليلة المقبلة، ستكشف بعض أكبر شركات التكنولوجيا في العالم عن دفاتر حساباتها للربع الأخير.

segments.src: Revenue and profit will get the headlines, as they always do.
segments.tr: ستتصدر الإيرادات والأرباح عناوين الأخبار، كما هو الحال دائمًا.

segments.src: But this earnings season, the number many investors care about most sits a little further down the page: **how much these companies are spending on chips and data centers, and whether that spending is beginning to pay off.**
segments.tr: ولكن في موسم الأرباح هذا، فإن الرقم الذي يهتم به العديد من المستثمرين أكثر من غيره يقع في مكان أدنى قليلاً في الصفحة: **مقدار ما تنفقه هذه الشركات على الرقائق ومراكز البيانات، وما إذا كان هذا الإنفاق بدأ يؤتي ثماره.**

segments.src: That question matters well beyond Wall Street.
segments.tr: هذا السؤال يهم ما هو أبعد بكثير من وول ستريت.

segments.src: The answer can influence tech stock prices, the value of retirement accounts that hold them, and the pace of the broader economy.
segments.tr: يمكن للإجابة أن تؤثر على أسعار أسهم التكنولوجيا، وقيمة حسابات التقاعد التي تمتلكها، ووتيرة الاقتصاد الأوسع.

segments.src: ## Why this earnings season is different
segments.tr: ## لماذا يختلف موسم الأرباح هذا

segments.src: For years, big tech earnings followed a familiar script: advertising, cloud subscriptions, devices and software.
segments.tr: لسنوات، اتبعت أرباح شركات التكنولوجيا الكبرى سيناريو مألوفاً: الإعلانات، واشتراكات السحابة، والأجهزة، والبرمجيات.

segments.src: Since the rise of generative artificial intelligence, a new line item has taken center stage.
segments.tr: منذ ظهور الذكاء الاصطناعي التوليدي، احتل بند جديد مركز الصدارة.

segments.src: **Capital expenditures**, often shortened to "capex," refers to money spent on long-lived assets such as data centers, servers, networking gear and specialized AI chips.
segments.tr: **النفقات الرأسمالية**، والتي تُختصر غالباً بـ "capex"، تشير إلى الأموال المنفقة على الأصول طويلة الأجل مثل مراكز البيانات، والخوادم، ومعدات الشبكات، ورقائق الذكاء الاصطناعي المتخصصة.

segments.src: Across the industry, the combined capex plans of the largest cloud and platform companies have climbed to levels that analysts often describe in the hundreds of billions of dollars per year.
segments.tr: عبر الصناعة، ارتفعت خطط النفقات الرأسمالية المجمعة لأكبر شركات السحابة والمنصات إلى مستويات يصفها المحللون غالباً بمئات المليارات من الدولارات سنوياً.

segments.src: Taken together with commitments over several years, the total is frequently framed as a trillion-dollar bet that AI will become a core part of how people and businesses work.
segments.tr: وإذا أخذنا في الاعتبار الالتزامات على مدى عدة سنوات، فغالباً ما يتم تأطير الإجمالي كرهان بقيمة تريليون دولار على أن الذكاء الاصطناعي سيصبح جزءاً أساسياً من كيفية عمل الناس والشركات.

segments.src: A bet that large raises an obvious question: where is the return?
segments.tr: رهان بهذا الحجم يطرح سؤالاً بديهياً: أين العائد؟

segments.src: ## What investors will be watching
segments.tr: ## ما الذي سيراقبه المستثمرون

segments.src: Analysts and investors are likely to focus on a handful of signals:
segments.tr: من المرجح أن يركز المحللون والمستثمرون على حفنة من الإشارات:

segments.src: - **Capex guidance.** Did companies raise, hold or trim their spending plans for the coming year? A higher number can signal confidence in demand, but it can also raise worries about profit margins.
segments.tr: - **توجيهات النفقات الرأسمالية.** هل رفعت الشركات خطط إنفاقها للعام المقبل، أم أبقتها كما هي، أم قلصتها؟ يمكن أن يشير الرقم الأعلى إلى الثقة في الطلب، ولكنه قد يثير أيضاً مخاوف بشأن هوامش الربح.

segments.src: - **Cloud growth.** Cloud divisions are where much of the AI demand shows up first. Faster growth, and commentary about backlogs of customer commitments, would suggest the infrastructure is being put to use.
segments.tr: - **نمو السحابة.** أقسام السحابة هي المكان الذي يظهر فيه الكثير من الطلب على الذكاء الاصطناعي أولاً. النمو الأسرع، والتعليقات حول تراكم التزامات العملاء، سيشير إلى أن البنية التحتية قيد الاستخدام.

segments.src: - **Capacity constraints.** Executives often say demand exceeds the computing capacity they can supply. If that remains true, it supports the case for continued building. If it fades, the tone may change.
segments.tr: - **قيود القدرة.** غالباً ما يقول المسؤولون التنفيذيون إن الطلب يتجاوز القدرة الحوسبية التي يمكنهم توفيرها. إذا ظل هذا صحيحاً، فإنه يدعم قضية استمرار البناء. وإذا تلاشت، فقد تتغير النبرة.

segments.src: - **Margins and depreciation.** Servers and chips lose value over time, and that cost flows through the income statement as depreciation. Rising depreciation can weigh on profits even when revenue is growing.
segments.tr: - **الهوامش والاستهلاك.** تفقد الخوادم والرقائق قيمتها بمرور الوقت، وتتدفق هذه التكلفة عبر بيان الدخل كاستهلاك. يمكن أن يؤدي ارتفاع الاستهلاك إلى الضغط على الأرباح حتى عندما تنمو الإيرادات.

segments.src: - **AI revenue disclosure.** Some companies share figures on AI-related products or customer usage. Any new detail on how many people and businesses are paying for these tools will be closely scrutinized.
segments.tr: - **الإفصاح عن إيرادات الذكاء الاصطناعي.** تشارك بعض الشركات أرقاماً حول المنتجات المتعلقة بالذكاء الاصطناعي أو استخدام العملاء. سيتم فحص أي تفاصيل جديدة حول عدد الأشخاص والشركات الذين يدفعون مقابل هذه الأدوات بدقة.

segments.src: - **Free cash flow.** When spending rises quickly, the cash left over after investment can shrink. Investors will check whether companies are funding the buildout from operations or leaning more on debt.
segments.tr: - **التدفق النقدي الحر.** عندما يرتفع الإنفاق بسرعة، يمكن أن يتقلص النقد المتبقي بعد الاستثمار. سيتحقق المستثمرون مما إذا كانت الشركات تمول التوسع من العمليات التشغيلية أو تعتمد أكثر على الديون.

segments.src: ## The case for patience
segments.tr: ## مبررات الصبر

segments.src: Supporters of the spending argue that large infrastructure cycles take time to mature.
segments.tr: يجادل مؤيدو الإنفاق بأن دورات البنية التحتية الكبيرة تستغرق وقتاً لتنضج.

segments.src: Railroads, electric grids and the early internet all required heavy upfront investment before their economic benefits became clear.
segments.tr: تطلبت السكك الحديدية، وشبكات الكهرباء، والإنترنت في بداياته استثمارات أولية ضخمة قبل أن تصبح فوائدها الاقتصادية واضحة.

segments.src: In this view, the companies building AI capacity today are positioning for a long period of growth, and falling behind could be costlier than overbuilding.
segments.tr: من وجهة النظر هذه، فإن الشركات التي تبني قدرات الذكاء الاصطناعي اليوم تتمركز لفترة طويلة من النمو، وقد يكون التخلف عن الركب أكثر تكلفة من الإفراط في البناء.

segments.src: There is also evidence that businesses are experimenting widely with AI for coding assistance, customer service, document analysis and research.
segments.tr: هناك أيضاً أدلة على أن الشركات تجرب الذكاء الاصطناعي على نطاق واسع للمساعدة في البرمجة، وخدمة العملاء، وتحليل المستندات، والبحث.

segments.src: If those pilots turn into everyday workflows, demand for computing power could keep rising.
segments.tr: إذا تحولت تلك التجارب إلى سير عمل يومي، فقد يستمر الطلب على قوة الحوسبة في الارتفاع.

segments.src: ## The case for caution
segments.tr: ## مبررات الحذر

segments.src: Skeptics point out that spending is arriving faster than proven revenue.
segments.tr: يشير المتشككون إلى أن الإنفاق يأتي أسرع من الإيرادات المثبتة.

segments.src: They note that some of the demand comes from a relatively small group of AI developers and that companies are, in part, selling to customers they also fund.
segments.tr: ويلاحظون أن بعض الطلب يأتي من مجموعة صغيرة نسبياً من مطوري الذكاء الاصطناعي، وأن الشركات تبيع، جزئياً، لعملاء تقوم هي بتمويلهم أيضاً.

segments.src: They also ask whether the pace of chip upgrades will make today's hardware obsolete sooner than expected, shortening the period in which it can earn a return.
segments.tr: كما يتساءلون عما إذا كانت وتيرة ترقيات الرقائق ستجعل أجهزة اليوم قديمة عفا عليها الزمن في وقت أقرب مما هو متوقع، مما يقصر الفترة التي يمكن أن تحقق فيها عائداً.

segments.src: Power supply is another constraint.
segments.tr: إمدادات الطاقة هي قيد آخر.

segments.src: Data centers need large amounts of electricity, and delays in securing grid connections or equipment can slow projects and raise costs.
segments.tr: تحتاج مراكز البيانات إلى كميات كبيرة من الكهرباء، ويمكن أن تؤدي التأخيرات في تأمين توصيلات الشبكة أو المعدات إلى إبطاء المشاريع وزيادة التكاليف.

segments.src: History offers a cautionary note: periods of enthusiastic building have sometimes been followed by corrections when expectations ran ahead of results.
segments.tr: يقدم التاريخ ملاحظة تحذيرية: فترات البناء الحماسي تبعتها أحياناً تصحيحات عندما سبقت التوقعات النتائج.

segments.src: Whether this cycle follows that path is exactly what investors are trying to judge.
segments.tr: ما إذا كانت هذه الدورة تتبع هذا المسار هو بالضبط ما يحاول المستثمرون الحكم عليه.

segments.src: ## Why it matters to everyday households
segments.tr: ## لماذا يهم هذا الأسر العادية

segments.src: Many people own these companies without realizing it.
segments.tr: يمتلك الكثير من الناس هذه الشركات دون أن يدركوا ذلك.

segments.src: Large technology firms make up a significant share of popular index funds, and those funds sit inside 401(k)s, IRAs and target-date retirement portfolios.
segments.tr: تشكل شركات التكنولوجيا الكبيرة حصة كبيرة من صناديق المؤشرات الشائعة، وتلك الصناديق موجودة داخل حسابات 401(k)، وحسابات التقاعد الفردية (IRAs)، ومحافظ التقاعد ذات التاريخ المستهدف.

segments.src: When a handful of companies move sharply, broad market indexes can move with them.
segments.tr: عندما تتحرك حفنة من الشركات بشكل حاد، يمكن لمؤشرات السوق الواسعة أن تتحرك معها.

segments.src: The effects reach further than portfolios:
segments.tr: تصل التأثيرات إلى أبعد من المحافظ الاستثمارية:

segments.src: - **Jobs and construction.** Data center projects support work in construction, electrical equipment and energy.
segments.tr: - **الوظائف والبناء.** تدعم مشاريع مراكز البيانات العمل في البناء، والمعدات الكهربائية، والطاقة.

segments.src: - **Utilities and electricity demand.** Growing computing needs are influencing power planning in some regions.
segments.tr: - **المرافق والطلب على الكهرباء.** تؤثر احتياجات الحوسبة المتزايدة على تخطيط الطاقة في بعض المناطق.

segments.src: - **Business investment.** AI-related spending has become a noticeable contributor to overall corporate investment in the economy.
segments.tr: - **استثمار الأعمال.** أصبح الإنفاق المتعلق بالذكاء الاصطناعي مساهماً ملحوظاً في إجمالي استثمارات الشركات في الاقتصاد.

segments.src: - **Consumer products.** The tools built on this infrastructure are showing up in search, productivity software, phones and customer service.
segments.tr: - **منتجات المستهلك.** تظهر الأدوات المبنية على هذه البنية التحتية في البحث، وبرمجيات الإنتاجية، والهواتف، وخدمة العملاء.

segments.src: ## How to read the results
segments.tr: ## كيفية قراءة النتائج

segments.src: A few practical tips for following the news without getting lost in the noise:
segments.tr: بعض النصائح العملية لمتابعة الأخبار دون الضياع في الضجيج:

segments.src: 1. **Compare spending to growth.** A big capex number means little without context. Look at it alongside cloud revenue growth and operating margins.
segments.tr: 1. **قارن الإنفاق بالنمو.** رقم النفقات الرأسمالية الكبير لا يعني الكثير بدون سياق. انظر إليه جنباً إلى جنب مع نمو إيرادات السحابة وهوامش التشغيل.

segments.src: 2. **Listen to the tone on the call.** Language about demand, capacity and timelines often tells you more than a single figure.
segments.tr: 2. **استمع إلى نبرة الحديث في المكالمة.** غالباً ما تخبرك اللغة المتعلقة بالطلب والقدرة والجداول الزمنية أكثر من رقم واحد.

segments.src: 3. **Remember that one quarter is a snapshot.** Infrastructure returns play out over years, and stock reactions on earnings day can be short-lived.
segments.tr: 3. **تذكر أن الربع الواحد هو لقطة.** تلعب عوائد البنية التحتية دورها على مدى سنوات، ويمكن أن تكون ردود فعل الأسهم في يوم الأرباح قصيرة الأجل.

segments.src: 4. **Mind your own concentration.** If much of your savings is tied to a few large technology names, it may be worth understanding how your funds are weighted.
segments.tr: 4. **انتبه لتركيز استثماراتك.** إذا كان الكثير من مدخراتك مرتبطاً ببضع شركات تكنولوجيا كبيرة، فقد يكون من المفيد فهم كيفية ترجيح صناديقك.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## الخلاصة

segments.src: Next week's reports will not settle the debate over whether the AI buildout is a visionary investment or an overreach.
segments.tr: لن تحسم تقارير الأسبوع المقبل الجدل حول ما إذا كان توسع الذكاء الاصطناعي استثماراً رؤيوياً أم مبالغة.

segments.src: But they will add fresh evidence on both sides: how fast the spending is growing, how much customers are paying for it, and how comfortably companies can afford it.
segments.tr: لكنها ستضيف أدلة جديدة على كلا الجانبين: مدى سرعة نمو الإنفاق، ومقدار ما يدفعه العملاء مقابله، ومدى قدرة الشركات على تحمل تكاليفه براحة.

segments.src: For investors and savers alike, the receipt for the AI boom is starting to come into view.
segments.tr: بالنسبة للمستثمرين والمدخرين على حد سواء، بدأ إيصال طفرة الذكاء الاصطناعي في الظهور.

segments.src: How it reads may shape markets well into the new year.
segments.tr: كيفية قراءته قد تشكل الأسواق حتى العام الجديد.

segments.src: ## The case for patience
segments.tr: ## Le parti pris de la patience

segments.src: Supporters of the spending argue that large infrastructure cycles take time to mature.
segments.tr: Les partisans des dépenses soutiennent que les grands cycles d'infrastructure prennent du temps à mûrir.

segments.src: Railroads, electric grids and the early internet all required heavy upfront investment before their economic benefits became clear.
segments.tr: Les chemins de fer, les réseaux électriques et les débuts d'internet ont tous nécessité de lourds investissements initiaux avant que leurs avantages économiques ne deviennent évidents.

segments.src: In this view, the companies building AI capacity today are positioning for a long period of growth, and falling behind could be costlier than overbuilding.
segments.tr: Selon cette perspective, les entreprises qui développent la capacité d'IA aujourd'hui se positionnent pour une longue période de croissance, et prendre du retard pourrait s'avérer plus coûteux que de surconstruire.

segments.src: There is also evidence that businesses are experimenting widely with AI for coding assistance, customer service, document analysis and research.
segments.tr: Il est également prouvé que les entreprises expérimentent largement l'IA pour l'aide au codage, le service client, l'analyse de documents et la recherche.

segments.src: If those pilots turn into everyday workflows, demand for computing power could keep rising.
segments.tr: Si ces projets pilotes se transforment en flux de travail quotidiens, la demande en puissance de calcul pourrait continuer à augmenter.

segments.src: ## The case for caution
segments.tr: ## Le parti pris de la prudence

segments.src: Skeptics point out that spending is arriving faster than proven revenue.
segments.tr: Les sceptiques soulignent que les dépenses arrivent plus rapidement que les revenus avérés.

segments.src: They note that some of the demand comes from a relatively small group of AI developers and that companies are, in part, selling to customers they also fund.
segments.tr: Ils font remarquer qu'une partie de la demande provient d'un groupe relativement restreint de développeurs d'IA et que les entreprises vendent, en partie, à des clients qu'elles financent également.

segments.src: They also ask whether the pace of chip upgrades will make today's hardware obsolete sooner than expected, shortening the period in which it can earn a return.
segments.tr: Ils se demandent également si le rythme des mises à niveau des puces ne rendra pas le matériel d'aujourd'hui obsolète plus tôt que prévu, raccourcissant ainsi la période pendant laquelle il peut générer un rendement.

segments.src: Power supply is another constraint.
segments.tr: L'approvisionnement en électricité est une autre contrainte.

segments.src: Data centers need large amounts of electricity, and delays in securing grid connections or equipment can slow projects and raise costs.
segments.tr: Les centres de données ont besoin de grandes quantités d'électricité, et les retards dans l'obtention de raccordements au réseau ou d'équipements peuvent ralentir les projets et augmenter les coûts.

segments.src: History offers a cautionary note: periods of enthusiastic building have sometimes been followed by corrections when expectations ran ahead of results.
segments.tr: L'histoire offre une note de prudence : les périodes de construction enthousiaste ont parfois été suivies de corrections lorsque les attentes ont devancé les résultats.

segments.src: Whether this cycle follows that path is exactly what investors are trying to judge.
segments.tr: Que ce cycle suive cette voie est précisément ce que les investisseurs tentent de juger.

segments.src: ## Why it matters to everyday households
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi c'est important pour les ménages ordinaires

segments.src: Many people own these companies without realizing it.
segments.tr: Beaucoup de gens possèdent ces entreprises sans le savoir.

segments.src: Large technology firms make up a significant share of popular index funds, and those funds sit inside 401(k)s, IRAs and target-date retirement portfolios.
segments.tr: Les grandes entreprises technologiques représentent une part importante des fonds indiciels populaires, et ces fonds se trouvent dans les plans 401(k), les IRA et les portefeuilles de retraite à date cible.

segments.src: When a handful of companies move sharply, broad market indexes can move with them.
segments.tr: Lorsqu'une poignée d'entreprises bouge brusquement, les indices boursiers larges peuvent bouger avec elles.

segments.src: The effects reach further than portfolios:
segments.tr: Les effets vont au-delà des portefeuilles :

segments.src: - **Jobs and construction.** Data center projects support work in construction, electrical equipment and energy.
segments.tr: - **Emplois et construction.** Les projets de centres de données soutiennent le travail dans la construction, l'équipement électrique et l'énergie.

segments.src: - **Utilities and electricity demand.** Growing computing needs are influencing power planning in some regions.
segments.tr: - **Services publics et demande d'électricité.** Les besoins croissants en matière de calcul influencent la planification énergétique dans certaines régions.

segments.src: - **Business investment.** AI-related spending has become a noticeable contributor to overall corporate investment in the economy.
segments.tr: - **Investissement des entreprises.** Les dépenses liées à l'IA sont devenues un contributeur notable à l'investissement des entreprises dans l'économie.

segments.src: - **Consumer products.** The tools built on this infrastructure are showing up in search, productivity software, phones and customer service.
segments.tr: - **Produits grand public.** Les outils construits sur cette infrastructure apparaissent dans la recherche, les logiciels de productivité, les téléphones et le service client.

segments.src: ## How to read the results
segments.tr: ## Comment lire les résultats

segments.src: A few practical tips for following the news without getting lost in the noise:
segments.tr: Quelques conseils pratiques pour suivre l'actualité sans se perdre dans le bruit :

segments.src: 1. **Compare spending to growth.** A big capex number means little without context. Look at it alongside cloud revenue growth and operating margins.
segments.tr: 1. **Comparer les dépenses à la croissance.** Un chiffre important de capex ne signifie pas grand-chose sans contexte. Examinez-le en parallèle avec la croissance des revenus du cloud et les marges d'exploitation.

segments.src: 2. **Listen to the tone on the call.** Language about demand, capacity and timelines often tells you more than a single figure.
segments.tr: 2. **Écouter le ton lors de la conférence téléphonique.** Le langage concernant la demande, la capacité et les délais en dit souvent plus qu'un simple chiffre.

segments.src: 3. **Remember that one quarter is a snapshot.** Infrastructure returns play out over years, and stock reactions on earnings day can be short-lived.
segments.tr: 3. **Se rappeler qu'un trimestre est un instantané.** Les rendements des infrastructures se déploient sur des années, et les réactions boursières le jour des résultats peuvent être de courte durée.

segments.src: 4. **Mind your own concentration.** If much of your savings is tied to a few large technology names, it may be worth understanding how your funds are weighted.
segments.tr: 4. **Surveiller votre propre concentration.** Si une grande partie de vos épargnes est liée à quelques grands noms de la technologie, il peut être utile de comprendre comment vos fonds sont pondérés.

segments.src: ## The bottom line
segments.tr: ## L'essentiel

segments.src: Next week's reports will not settle the debate over whether the AI buildout is a visionary investment or an overreach.
segments.tr: Les rapports de la semaine prochaine ne régleront pas le débat sur la question de savoir si le développement de l'IA est un investissement visionnaire ou une démesure.

segments.src: But they will add fresh evidence on both sides: how fast the spending is growing, how much customers are paying for it, and how comfortably companies can afford it.
segments.tr: Mais ils ajouteront de nouvelles preuves des deux côtés : la vitesse à laquelle les dépenses augmentent, le montant que les clients paient pour cela et la facilité avec laquelle les entreprises peuvent se le permettre.

segments.src: For investors and savers alike, the receipt for the AI boom is starting to come into view.
segments.tr: Pour les investisseurs comme pour les épargnants, le reçu du boom de l'IA commence à se dessiner.

pt.title: O Recibo de Gastos com IA: O que os Lucros da Big Tech na Próxima Semana Revelarão sobre uma Aposta de Um Trilhão de Dólares

segments.src: Over the next several days, some of the largest technology companies in the world will open their books for the latest quarter.
segments.tr: Nos próximos dias, algumas das maiores empresas de tecnologia do mundo abrirão seus livros para o trimestre mais recente.

segments.src: Revenue and profit will get the headlines, as they always do.
segments.tr: Receita e lucro ocuparão as manchetes, como sempre fazem.

segments.src: But this earnings season, the number many investors care about most sits a little further down the page: **how much these companies are spending on chips and data centers, and whether that spending is beginning to pay off.**
segments.tr: Mas nesta temporada de balanços, o número com o qual muitos investidores se importam mais está um pouco mais abaixo na página: **quanto essas empresas estão gastando em chips e data centers, e se esse gasto está começando a dar resultado.**

segments.src: That question matters well beyond Wall Street.
segments.tr: Essa pergunta importa muito além de Wall Street.

segments.src: The answer can influence tech stock prices, the value of retirement accounts that hold them, and the pace of the broader economy.
segments.tr: A resposta pode influenciar os preços das ações de tecnologia, o valor das contas de aposentadoria que as possuem e o ritmo da economia em geral.

segments.src: ## Why this earnings season is different
segments.tr: ## Por que esta temporada de balanços é diferente

segments.src: For years, big tech earnings followed a familiar script: advertising, cloud subscriptions, devices and software.
segments.tr: Por anos, os lucros das grandes empresas de tecnologia seguiram um roteiro familiar: publicidade, assinaturas de nuvem, dispositivos e software.

segments.src: Since the rise of generative artificial intelligence, a new line item has taken center stage.
segments.tr: Desde o surgimento da inteligência artificial generativa, um novo item de linha assumiu o centro das atenções.

segments.src: **Capital expenditures**, often shortened to "capex," refers to money spent on long-lived assets such as data centers, servers, networking gear and specialized AI chips.
segments.tr: **Despesas de capital**, frequentemente abreviadas como "capex", referem-se ao dinheiro gasto em ativos de longa duração, como data centers, servidores, equipamentos de rede e chips de IA especializados.

segments.src: Across the industry, the combined capex plans of the largest cloud and platform companies have climbed to levels that analysts often describe in the hundreds of billions of dollars per year.
segments.tr: Em todo o setor, os planos combinados de capex das maiores empresas de nuvem e plataformas subiram a níveis que os analistas frequentemente descrevem na casa das centenas de bilhões de dólares por ano.

segments.src: Taken together with commitments over several years, the total is frequently framed as a trillion-dollar bet that AI will become a core part of how people and businesses work.
segments.tr: Tomado em conjunto com compromissos ao longo de vários anos, o total é frequentemente enquadrado como uma aposta de um trilhão de dólares de que a IA se tornará uma parte central de como as pessoas e as empresas trabalham.

segments.src: A bet that large raises an obvious question: where is the return?
segments.tr: Uma aposta tão grande levanta uma pergunta óbvia: onde está o retorno?

segments.src: ## What investors will be watching
segments.tr: ## O que os investidores estarão observando

segments.src: Analysts and investors are likely to focus on a handful of signals:
segments.tr: Analistas e investidores provavelmente focarão em um punhado de sinais:

segments.src: - **Capex guidance.** Did companies raise, hold or trim their spending plans for the coming year? A higher number can signal confidence in demand, but it can also raise worries about profit margins.
segments.tr: - **Orientação de capex.** As empresas aumentaram, mantiveram ou reduziram seus planos de gastos para o próximo ano? Um número maior pode sinalizar confiança na demanda, mas também pode aumentar as preocupações sobre margens de lucro.

segments.src: - **Cloud growth.** Cloud divisions are where much of the AI demand shows up first. Faster growth, and commentary about backlogs of customer commitments, would suggest the infrastructure is being put to use.
segments.tr: - **Crescimento da nuvem.** As divisões de nuvem são onde grande parte da demanda de IA aparece primeiro. Um crescimento mais rápido e comentários sobre atrasos nos compromissos dos clientes sugerem que a infraestrutura está sendo colocada em uso.

segments.src: - **Capacity constraints.** Executives often say demand exceeds the computing capacity they can supply. If that remains true, it supports the case for continued building. If it fades, the tone may change.
segments.tr: - **Restrições de capacidade.** Os executivos frequentemente dizem que a demanda excede a capacidade de computação que podem fornecer. Se isso continuar verdade, sustenta o argumento para a construção contínua. Se enfraquecer, o tom pode mudar.

segments.src: - **Margins and depreciation.** Servers and chips lose value over time, and that cost flows through the income statement as depreciation. Rising depreciation can weigh on profits even when revenue is growing.
segments.tr: - **Margens e depreciação.** Servidores e chips perdem valor ao longo do tempo, e esse custo flui através da demonstração de resultados como depreciação. O aumento da depreciação pode pesar sobre os lucros, mesmo quando a receita está crescendo.

segments.src: - **AI revenue disclosure.** Some companies share figures on AI-related products or customer usage. Any new detail on how many people and businesses are paying for these tools will be closely scrutinized.
segments.tr: - **Divulgação de receita de IA.** Algumas empresas compartilham números sobre produtos relacionados à IA ou uso de clientes. Qualquer detalhe novo sobre quantas pessoas e empresas estão pagando por essas ferramentas será escrutinado de perto.

segments.src: - **Free cash flow.** When spending rises quickly, the cash left over after investment can shrink. Investors will check whether companies are funding the buildout from operations or leaning more on debt.
segments.tr: - **Fluxo de caixa livre.** Quando os gastos aumentam rapidamente, o dinheiro restante após o investimento pode encolher. Os investidores verificarão se as empresas estão financianado a expansão a partir das operações ou recorrendo mais a dívidas.
